title: A better way to recycle cars?
summary: Is there a better way to recycle old cars? For decades, most end-of-life cars have been crushed. Sure, the steel and aluminum in the vehicles can be recycled. But what if there was a smarter way to use an old car, to recover and repurpose viable parts, precious metals, or even plastics?

extra.full_text: Is there a better way to recycle old cars? For decades, most end-of-life cars have been crushed. Sure, the steel and aluminum in the vehicles can be recycled. But what if there was a smarter way to use an old car, to recover and repurpose viable parts, precious metals, or even plastics? In only one minute, Hakyung Kwon, a researcher at Toyota Research Institute, explains the concept of “vehicle circularity” and why Toyota is carefully cutting apart cars instead of just crushing them.
